text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. I need it for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
I've sent you the list in our DM. I went through all six of Moss's notes in the shared team files, and only two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers come up:

1. **#4419**, from Moss's undated North cheat sheet (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea Ramaswell logged it because the gatehouse scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.
2. **#PD-4492**, from Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" note dated 5 Oct 2025 (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Doors 14–18, 04:00 shift) weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments. Support patched it that evening and Thea confirmed the fix the next day.

Before this goes in the deck:
- **#4419 has two different descriptions.** Marcus's own note from 14 Jul 2025 (not one of Moss's) gives the same number but calls it Gate 3 printer lag on bill-of-lading printouts. One of the two is probably wrong, so check the actual ticket before you put it on a slide.
- **Moss's other two QFL notes have no ticket numbers.** Those are the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in.
- **Moss's Central notes aren't about QFL.** They mention #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are for Marrow accounts.
- **Don't mix up the names.** Quarendon Freightways is a different company and isn't a customer.
